name: pimarquee
description: Raspberry Pi digital signage: RTSP cameras, web pages, text and clock widgets with a web admin UI

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pimarquee/shared && npm run build -w @pimarquee/display && npm run build -w @pimarquee/admin && npm run build -w @pimarquee/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,admin,display -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @pimarquee/server" "npm run dev -w @pimarquee/admin" "npm run dev -w @pimarquee/display"
